title: Mind the Blind Spots: A Focus-Level Evaluation Framework for LLM Reviews

bias_targets.methodology: Computing a normalized focus distribution of attention across predefined academic paper review facets (such as targets like 'Method' and 'Experiment', and aspects like 'Validity' and 'Novelty') using an automatic annotator, and evaluating the discrepancy between LLM-generated reviews and human expert reviews using KL Divergence.
